newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Howard confirms Australia budget tightening.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Howard confirms Australia budget tightening.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Friday the government would have to undertake a further fiscal tightening in the May budget because of lower than expected tax receipts in the current year.
But this tightening would not be as severe as in the August 1996 Budget.

"We will need to undertake some further fiscal tightening in the May budget but it will be nohwere near as much as that undertaken in the last Budget," Howard told a Committee for Economic Development of Australia luncheon.
Austrlian Treasurer Peter Costello said this week after the release of a mid-year economic review that there would be a further tightening of the budget.
Howard also said the economy was in a strong position and Australia had entered a new era of low inflation.
"We have returned to an era quite decisively of very low inflation that we haven't seen since the pre-OPEC days of the early 1970s," he said.
